parameters.name: StatisticType
parameters.description:
The type of the statistics. Valid values:

*   **user**: the top five users that are granted excessive permissions.
*   **role**: the top five roles that are granted excessive permissions.
*   **instance**: the top five cloud services on which risks are detected.
*   **host**: the top five servers on which baseline risks are detected.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas get-check-count-statistic --vendors ALIYUN --statistic-type instance --lang zh --task-sources YAO_CHI --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas GetCheckCountStatistic --region cn-hangzhou --TaskSources.1 YAO_CHI --StatisticType instance --Vendors.1 ALIYUN --Lang zh
